bullets: • Remove duplicate CSS selectors and conflicting rules; never layer new styles atop old ones.
• Validate CSS syntax before submission: ensure all comment tags properly close with */.
• Implement pre-commit linting to detect duplicate selectors, unclosed comments, and specificity conflicts.
• For dynamic UI elements, verify JavaScript update logic exists; never hardcode placeholder values.
• Audit stylesheets for orphaned rules when modifying existing element styles; delete conflicting rules.
• Define distinct data sources and business logic for each new metric before implementation begins.
• Handle zero and missing data consistently: display "0" not dashes; implement fallback logic explicitly.
• Verify that changelog entries match actual code changes in HTML/CSS/JS files before submission.
